d:
The Pistons defeated the Wizards, 144-140 tonight in Washington. Cade Cunningham finished with a team-high 52 points along with 11 assists and 5 rebounds for the Pistons, while Daniss Jenkins tallied 21 points, 6 rebounds and 3 three pointers in the game. Trae Young recorded 37 points, 14 assists and 4 three pointers. The Pistons improve their record to 8-3 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-9 for the season.
